items.caption: Unzipped: illustration
items.details: A woman's face unzipping out of a black dual-profile silhouette mask on burnt orange: spiral eyes, bindi, nose ring, zipper down the center.

items.caption: Abolissez l'article 222: campaign poster
items.details: Campaign poster calling for the abolition of Article 222 of the Moroccan penal code, which punishes publicly breaking the Ramadan fast with prison and a fine. A tagine served on a toilet, with the hashtag #MangerNestPasUnCrime (eating is not a crime).

items.caption: Love Is Not a Crime: poster
items.details: Red-square poster: white lettering where the 'o' in Love is a keyhole and the 'C' in Crime is a handcuff, over background words (Code pénal, Droits Humains, Liberté…).

items.caption: Boxing uterus: illustration
items.details: Orange uterus wearing white polka-dot boxing gloves attached to its fallopian tubes, on dark gray.

items.caption: Balacona hip hop night: event poster
items.details: Poster for Balacona's hip hop night in Amsterdam (30/07/2022): Mehdi Black Wind with Lyllice, Kourosh, Kruloh, Enana and OTAT, with DJs Mamakil and Retro Casetta. Supported by Waraqlab and the Arab Fund for Arts and Culture.

items.caption: Into the void: illustration
items.details: Surreal minimalist illustration: a white figure falling legs-first into a black hole on deep blue with floating black ovals.

items.caption: Silenced strings: collage
items.details: Art-direction collage: a violinist portrait behind bars with Arabic typography in the background.

items.caption: Scream: illustration
items.details: Surreal cartoon: a giant red screaming mouth on teal blue, with four stretched orange fists streaming leftward.

items.caption: Body series: collage
items.details: Art-direction collage from a series on the body: Arabic calligraphy layered over a duotone male torso on deep blue.

items.caption: Siyada Network: debt crisis study poster
items.details: Promo graphic for Siyada Network's December 2023 study on debt and food dependency in Egypt: 'أزمة الديون والتبعية الغذائية في مصر', with booklet and smartphone mockups.

items.caption: Hands in motion: collage
items.details: Art-direction collage: cut-out arms and hands in black and white over peach and pink geometric circles.

items.caption: Afro and parrot: illustration
items.details: Colorful cartoon: a shirtless yellow-skinned man with a big white afro and a parrot on his head, holding up his pants, against green with Arabic-style calligraphy doodles.

items.caption: Submerged: collage
items.details: Art-direction collage: a submerged figure in teal duotone, part of a series on the body.

items.caption: Masked: collage
items.details: Art-direction collage: a face assembled from pink protective masks, ringed by pointing hands on green, a pandemic-era piece.
